items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially active vs Raiders despite calf injury; earlier optimism confirmed.
items.why: Feeling better Saturday, no setbacks, McVay optimistic
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; Adams already out long-term
items.opportunity: Full target share likely vs LV

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall inactive vs Dolphins; officially out after quad strain, unlikely earlier reports confirmed.
items.why: Quad strain, limited practice, not full participant
items.implication: Braelon Allen lead back again; strong matchup vs MIA

items.text: ETR weekend summary: Puka GTD/opt (later active), Breece GTD/pess (later inactive), Lamar OUT, Saquon expected, Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell IN, Smith/Wicks OUT.
items.implication: Projections updated; key pivots for DFS/lineups

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled out for Sunday vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley to start again.
items.why: High ankle sprain, missed prior games
items.implication: Huntley starts; Flowers target spike expected
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers volume up with Huntley

items.text: Christian McCaffrey went to locker room then returned during game; earlier smile on possible slot usage amid 49ers WR outs.
items.why: In-game movement to locker then back
items.implication: Monitor for injury but cleared return; WR outs (Evans/Deebo) boost receiving role
items.conflict: Levitan skeptical of RB-as-WR but tempted here

items.text: Actives include Vikings RB Jordan Mason, Texans WR Tank Dell, Browns RB Dylan Sampson, Bucs QB Baker Mayfield; Ridley inactive.
items.implication: Mason flex option; Dell return; Mayfield back

items.text: Lamar/Puka/Breece statuses crucial for DFS slate; sneaky scratches include Egbuka, BRob, Warren; tempted by CMC slot amid 49ers WR outs despite usual skepticism on RB-WR claims. Projections updated.
items.why: Injury impact on main slate and 49ers WR injuries (Evans/Deebo out)
items.implication: Adjust DFS; CMC receiving upside possible
items.opportunity: CMC routes if used in slot

items.text: Saquon Barkley expected to play MNF vs DAL despite Q tag; DeVonta/Wicks out.
items.implication: Start as RB1/2 with volume; WRs out boosts him

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN and active; returning from layoff.
Texans WR Tank Dell activated and active for first NFL action in nearly two years vs NYG.
items.implication: WR depth returns; monitor target share with Collins
items.opportunity: Dell flex upside if limited but involved

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith ruled out for MNF vs Cowboys; Dontayvion Wicks also out.
items.implication: PHI pass game thinned; Saquon expected, more RB/TE focus possible

items.text: Berry: Jonah Coleman should be rostered in 100% of leagues; will be Broncos RB you wish you had by year end. IN this week.
Broncos CB Pat Surtain II officially inactive (ankle); unlikely earlier, good chance next week.
items.implication: Softer coverage for ARI pass catchers like MHJ

items.text: Berry top overall W7: high on Puka (pre-active confirm), JSN, etc.; Warren top-15 play. Updated ranks available.
items.why: Matchups and volume; Puka faith rewarded by active

items.text: Emeka Egbuka OUT (among sneaky scratches per Levitan); already listed in prior outs with Warren, BRob etc.
items.implication: TB WR depth thinned with Mayfield back

items.text: Davante Adams OUT (hamstring surgery, 6-10 weeks); boosts Puka/remaining Rams pass catchers long-term.
items.implication: Puka nuclear target share ROS when healthy
items.opportunity: Puka WR1 lock; TEs elevated short-term

items.text: Matthew Berry loves A.J. Brown usage/matchup vs CHI; also volume RBs and Kraft TE buffet vs DET.
items.why: Usage and soft matchups; Lions TE-friendly D
items.implication: Start with confidence in flex/WR/TE spots

items.text: Berry hates Josh Jacobs post-layoff workload questions vs DET; also fades Odunze (shadow), Downs, Kelce tough D.
items.implication: Sit or lower expectations if starting
